Rejuvenate your skin naturally with SkinPen® Microneedling at AestheticEye, where precision meets innovation. As the first FDA-cleared microneedling device, SkinPen is clinically proven to improve the appearance of fine lines, acne scars, and overall skin texture – without the need for surgery or extensive downtime. Under the care of Dr. Jonathan Pargament, a board-certified oculoplastic surgeon serving patients in Cincinnati and Dayton, you can achieve firmer, smoother, and more radiant skin with this advanced, collagen-boosting treatment.

How SkinPen® Works: Precision Meets Regeneration

SkinPen works by creating thousands of controlled micro-injuries to the skin’s surface, triggering the body’s natural wound-healing process. This stimulates collagen and elastin production—the building blocks of healthy, youthful skin. According to the American Society of Plastic Surgeons, microneedling has seen a popularity surge of 55% in recent years, driven by its ability to improve skin tone and reduce signs of aging without invasive measures.

The three-phase process includes:

Inflammation

Tiny punctures trigger an immune response, cleansing the wound and increasing blood flow.

Proliferation

New tissue and blood vessels begin to form.

Remodeling

Collagen and elastin strengthen the skin for lasting firmness and elasticity.

What Can SkinPen® Treat?

This versatile treatment is effective for a wide range of skin concerns, including:

  • Fine lines and wrinkles
  • Acne scars
  • Enlarged pores
  • Uneven skin texture
  • Stretch marks
  • Mild skin laxity

SkinPen can be safely used on the face, neck, décolletage, and other body areas to achieve a more youthful and even-toned appearance.

What to Expect During Your SkinPen® Session

1. Consultation

We evaluate your skin type, concerns, and goals to determine if SkinPen is right for you.

2. Preparation

A topical numbing cream is applied to minimize discomfort.

3. Treatment

The SkinPen device glides across the treatment area, creating precise micro-channels.

4. Aftercare

You may experience redness similar to a mild sunburn for 1-3 days. Most patients resume normal activities within 24 hours.

Benefits of SkinPen® Microneedling

• FDA-Cleared for both facial acne scars and fine lines
• Minimally Invasive with little to no downtime
• Safe for All Skin Types
• Natural Collagen Boosting for ongoing improvement
• Can Be Combined with other skincare treatments for enhanced results

Frequently Asked Questions About SkinPen®

How many treatments will I need?

Most patients benefit from a series of 3 treatments spaced about 4 weeks apart. Maintenance sessions can extend your results.

Is microneedling painful?

A topical anesthetic makes the procedure very tolerable, with most patients reporting only mild discomfort.

When will I see results?

Visible improvement typically begins within a week, with continued collagen remodeling over several months.

Is there any downtime?

Redness and mild swelling may occur, but most people return to normal activities within 24-48 hours.
